additional_info.subject: Re: ID0451478-DC/Si-D/SA-[Y2/SD 314005673001] AC Socket Failure CRM:03055000040
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Mr. Dakroury,
Thank you for your email. I am glad to hear that the AC socket works fine now!
Regarding your first question: yes, charging sessions (AC or DC) can always be stopped directly from the charger itself.
I must admit I’m not familiar with the screen flow for AC charging shown in the picture you attached. I believe the instructions in the image are specific to firmware version v4.0.11, which is approximately 1.5 years old. It’s possible that, with that firmware, AC charging sessions authenticated from the Backend could only be stopped through the app itself.
I’ve just tested the screen flow of an AC charging session authenticated from Backend on the latest firmware version (v8.0.5), and I can confirm that it can always be stopped directly from the charger’s HMI.
This relates to your second point regarding firmware updates on the charger. Being the charger in v4.0.11, the FW updates required to be performed OTA to bring the charger to the latest major FW versions are 4 (v4 > v5 > v6 > v7 > v8). Already from v6, major old bugs are solved, while v8 is the most stable version and provides the best performance and reliability of the charger. Moreover, given the age of the FW v4.0.11, Technical Support team will not prioritize troubleshooting or bug analysis related to such an outdated FW version. That is why we kindly recommend updating the charger to the latest version..
In order to proceed with the FW updates, please consider that:
Each OTA (over-the-air) FW update consumes roughly 2GB of data on the XF3 router (Siemens router). Therefore, it is important to make sure that the SIM card has enough data to perform the updates.
Each FW update takes roughly 1 hour to rollout the FW from the cloud to the charger (according to bandwidth and connection speed), and 30 mins to update the charger.
If you require the technical support team to perform the updates, these can be performed during normal working hours (9-5), not during nights or weekends.
I trust this answers your questions. Please let me know if you require further support, and if you are willing to proceed with the FW updates.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you soon!
With kind regards,
